negative_findings.description: No Hungary-specific job board or filter dedicated to regulatory/compliance roles in financial services was found; there is no HU equivalent of a 'regtech/compliance jobs' vertical board. All signal must be extracted by keyword filtering on general boards and employer career portals.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched hu and en for sector-specific HU compliance job portals; only general boards (profession.hu, CVOnline, Jobline, Jooble, Indeed) and employer/agency sites surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must be keyword-driven and multi-source rather than relying on a single vertical feed, raising noise and requiring a curated HU glossary.

negative_findings.description: Hungarian-language queries combining instant payments terminology with hiring ('állás azonnali fizetési rendszer AFR pénzforgalom projektvezető szabályozás bank') returned regulatory and market content (MNB rules, qvik/AFR 2.0 analysis) but no job advertisements.
negative_findings.result_summary: AFR/qvik hiring signal is not reachable via open web search; it sits behind board search forms and employer ATS listings that general search engines index poorly or late.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The instant-payments limb of this cell needs direct on-site searching of profession.hu, GIRO and bank career portals rather than search-engine discovery; treat absence of search hits as an indexing artefact, not absence of hiring.

negative_findings.description: Exact open-positions listing URLs for UniCredit Bank Hungary and JobsGarden were not pinned down; only section/landing pages were observed. UniCredit HU roles may be hosted on the UniCredit group ATS rather than the .hu domain.
negative_findings.result_summary: Landing pages identified (unicreditbank.hu/hu/rolunk/karrier..., jobsgarden.hu) but not the canonical vacancy list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These entries need one resolution pass before automated monitoring; recorded as unverified rather than dead.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn Jobs, the richest source for English-titled Budapest hub roles and recruiter posts naming client regulatory programmes, is login-gated and its ToS prohibits scraping.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only public search-result stubs are visible without authentication.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A meaningful share of the cell's signal is only collectable manually or via a licensed data provider; budget human review time or accept a coverage gap.

negative_findings.description: No public Hungarian source was found that tracks consultancy engagement wins or programme staffing for banks (no HU equivalent of a public tender/consulting-mandate register covering private banks). Only the consultancies' own recruitment ads are visible.
negative_findings.result_summary: Big Four HU career pages found; no register of who is staffing which bank's regulatory programme.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Attribution from consultancy hiring to a specific institution's programme will remain inferential, not evidenced.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller and specialist HU institutions were not covered: Gránit Bank, Magnet Bank, savings/credit cooperatives, Takarék-successor entities, Revolut Hungary (branch/licensed entity), Barion, OTP Mobil (Simple), and card/ATM processors — all subject to the same DORA/AML/instant-payments deadlines.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an actor list from the MNB institution register, then resolve a career-page URL per institution and add to the weekly watchlist.

coverage_gaps.description: Technology and outsourcing vendors serving HU banks (core-banking, payments, AML/transaction-monitoring, regulatory-reporting software and their local integrators) were not enumerated. Their HU job ads name the client-side deadline drivers as clearly as bank ads do.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate vendors from MNB DORA ICT-third-party registry context and HU banking-IT trade press, then monitor their HU career pages and profession.hu advertiser pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Organisational-change signals other than job ads (new directorates, executive appointments, internal reorganisations announced in press releases, cégjegyzék/company-register officer changes) were not scouted in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add HU company-register (e-cegjegyzek/Opten/Bisnode) officer-change monitoring and bank press-release feeds as a complementary weak-signal channel.

coverage_gaps.description: Job ads expire and are removed, so no historical baseline exists unless snapshots start now; several sources also lack visible posting dates in listing views.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin weekly snapshotting immediately with full ad text and first-seen/last-seen timestamps; consider archive.org submission for high-value ads.

coverage_gaps.description: The HU glossary used here is a first pass; terms not yet exercised include 'IKT-kockázatkezelés', 'digitális működési reziliencia', 'pénzmosás megelőzése', 'ügyfél-átvilágítás', 'belső ellenőrzés', 'kockázati kontroll', 'jelentésszolgálat', 'MNB ERA', 'STR/gyanús tranzakció bejelentés'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Expand the query set with these terms across profession.hu, CVOnline and Jooble; measure hit rate per term and prune noisy ones (e.g. bare 'compliance', which also matches tax/ESG roles).

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage is Budapest-centric; regional boards (pecsallas.hu, egerallas.hu and similar) carry banking ads for branch and back-office locations outside the capital and were only glimpsed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample two or three regional boards for a quarter to test whether they carry any regulatory-programme roles; drop if noise dominates.

brief: Hungary's hiring-signal landscape for regulatory weak signals is concentrated and tractable: profession.hu dominates the general board market (~90% share) with CVOnline.hu and Jobline.hu behind it, while every major institution also runs its own career portal — OTP, MBH, Erste, K&H, Raiffeisen, CIB, UniCredit — several on the shared karrierportal.hu ATS, which makes one parser reusable across tenants. The highest-signal direct sources are the two MNB-linked ones: the MNB's own Karrier/Álláslehetőségek page, where supervisory capacity build-out (DORA/ICT-risk, payments oversight, adatszolgáltatás) is visible, and GIRO Zrt.'s portal, since GIRO operates the BKR clearing and instant-payment infrastructure. Consultancy staffing (Deloitte Risk & Regulatory FSI, KPMG, EY, PwC) and specialist agencies (Hays, Randstad) provide the earliest programme-capacity signal, though attribution to a named bank stays inferential. The main constraints are that no HU-specific compliance-jobs vertical exists (all signal is keyword-extracted), LinkedIn is login-walled, and instant-payments/AFR hiring is invisible to search engines and must be pulled directly from board and employer-portal search forms.
